title: New Green Card rules from September: Categories affected and those exempt
description: Beginning September 2026, USCIS mandates that Green Card applicants prove financial self-sufficiency to address public charge inadmissibility. This applies mainly to those pursuing family or employment-based applications, though exemptions exist for humanitarian categories such as refugees and trafficking survivors. The Form I-864, Affidavit of Support, is essential but doesn't alone assure application approval. In cases of inadmissibility on public charge terms, Public Charge Bonds are an available recourse.
